tei:div.tei:p: 305) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rtsa gsum spyi'i me mchod las bzhi lhun grub rin chen bang mdzod bzhugs so: 306)na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: o rgyan rdo rje 'chang la 'dud: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mthar phyin nas: lhag chad bskang zhing tshogs rdzogs phyir: spros bcas me mchod 'bul ba ni: las bzhi lhun grub gdams pa bstan: sa ma ya: sa chog sngon du song ba'i rjes: bsreg dkyil zlum dang gru bzhi pa: zla gam gru gsum tshul du brtsigs: shing ni sur dkar 'om bu dang: shug pa tsher ma can sogs bya: dbus 'bur lto ba rdo rjes mtshan: phyi rim 'dab brgyad de'i phyi la: rin chen pad+ma ral gri dang: lnga ldan 'od kyi drwa ba bkod: phyi nang gsang mchod bsreg rdzas sogs: ma tshang med pa legs par bshams: bdag bskyed sngon du song ba'i mthar: me mtshams bcad 307)la 'di skad do: hūm̐: shar lho me lha'i drang srong ma gtogs par: gnod byed log 'dren phyir dengs shig: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: ye shes me yis bsregs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa dz+wa la ram̐: mchod rdzas byin brlab bya: ku sha bkram pa ni: oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐: me sbar ba ni: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐: rlung g.yab ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: me dar ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod me dar g.yab: de nas sreg rdzas byin brlab ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs: swa bhā was sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las rin chen snod nang du: 'bru gsum 'od zhu bsreg 308)rdzas bsam mi khyab: dpag med nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin gyur: rab 'byams rgyal ba dgyes pa'i rjas su spel: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs: shap+da sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya sarba pū dza hoḥ nam mkha' mdzod sngags dang mchod pa'i sprin gzungs brjod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sogs rdo rje rtse gcig gi phyag rgyas bran: de nas me lha bskyed pa ni:

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs: swa bhā wa=sogs: me thab mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: bh+rūm̐ las lhun grub gzhal yas dkyil 'khor dbus: raṃ las me lha ag+ne rā dza ni: dmar gsal khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan: phyag g.yas bgrang phreng dang ni dgang gzar 'dzin: drang srong cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa yi: zhabs gnyis ra skyes gdan la rol stabs bzhugs: gnas gsum 'bru gsum gsal las 'od 'phros pas: me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs dbyer med bstim: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: ngad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs me lha drang srong che: 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun: ye shes me dang gnyis med bzhugs: rab gus dad pas phyag bgyi'o: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol: de nas phyi nang gsang 309)mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ me lha drang srong 'khor bcas la: dngos 'byor yid las sprul pa ni: lha rdzas phyi yi mchod pa 'bul: nyon mongs ma spangs nang mchod 'bul: blang dor bral ba'i gsang mchod 'bul: sman raka gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin mchod pa 'bul: gnyis med de bzhin nyid mchod ni: drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bulaḥ bzhes nas las rnams lhun grub mdzod: oṃ aghā ye sarba sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs: shap+da rū pa shap+da ghan+dhe ra sa spar+she gu h+ya sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta pu kha dz+nyā na gu h+ya sarba pū dza hoḥ bstod pa ni: hrīḥ tshangs pa gzi brjid da'abar ba'i lha: las rnams ma lus 'grub mdzad pa'i: me lha drang srong 'khor 'das la: 'dod don bsgrub phyir phyag 'tshal bstod: me lha'i ljags ram̐ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros te bdud rtsi srog blug gi mchod pa 'di bzhes nas las rnams thams cad thogs med du 'grub par bsam: yam shing la: oṃ aghā ye bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swa hā: mar khu la: oṃ aghā ye pañca a mṛ ta kha hi:

til la: 310)oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā: yungs dkar la: oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ sarba ār+tha sid+dhi ye swā hā: zho zan la: oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ sarba sam+bha ye swā hā: 'bras la: oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā: so ba la: oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā: nas la: oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ badz+ra ma hā be ga ye swā hā: sran ma la: oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ badz+ra ma hā bā la ye swā hā: gro la: oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā: dū rba la: oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: ku sha la: oṃ ag+nā ye oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā: shing thog la: oṃ ag+nā ye gha gha ni bi lo ki te swā hā: rdzas 'dus la: oṃ ag+nā ye badz+ra sarba ho ma la ye swā hā: bdun nam nyer gcig res 'bul bar bya: zhi ba la: nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags 'jigs pa bcu drug thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa la: tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor gzi brjid ye shes yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang la: 'khor 'das srid gsum 'dod dgu'i longs spyod thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: drag po la: gnod byed 311)log 'dren dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: ces brjod cing 'dod gsol ni: zhi ba la: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: rgyas pa la: tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: dbang la: khams gsum skye 'gro zas nor longs spyod thams cad 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: drag po la: dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po log 'dren bdud dpung thams cad brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: de nas bsreg lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che'i nang: gzhal yas khang pa mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dbus: gzhung gi lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa rnams 'bul:

byon skyems ni rtsa sngags mthar: pañca a mṛ ta khā hi: lan bdun gyis 'bul: de nas rdzas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung ma bcos ye shes chen po'i rtsal: zag med bdud rtsi kun bzang mchod sprin gter: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dgyes bzhes dbang dang mchog thun dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags dang: bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ye sogs: mar khu til rdzas 'dus sogs gong ltar 'bul nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gang rung gi gsham bcas 312)bdun re'i mtshams 'dod gsol mchod rol bya: rtsa sngags dang: sa pā ri wā ra sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya sarba pū dza khā hi: las gzhung gi bstod pa bya: yi ge brgya pa bzla: de nas gtang rag ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dngos yid ting 'dzin dag pa chen po'i 'phrul: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsam mi khyab: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang mchog thun dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags dang: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yā sogs nas phyi nang gsang mchod sbyor sgrol sngags kyis 'bul: de nas rtsa sngags dang rdzas sngags sham bu med pa'i bsreg rdzas gong ltar lan bdun bdun 'bul: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral chos sku skye ba med: lhun grub rig stong dkyil dang 'khor gyi lha: du ma ro gcig mnyam nyid chen po'i klong: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus dgongs su gsol: gsang gsum mi zad rdo rje'i klong yangs nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thams cad kun: sgrub mchog bdag la ma lus bstsal du gsol: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i= khams gsum dbang du 'du ba'i= 313)log 'dren gdug pa tshar gcod= don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa'i= rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐:

rdzas la rol: yungs dkar dang rdzas lhag me nang du 'bul: yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod: sreg lha gshegs gsol ni: hrīḥ chos nyid sgyu ma'i skur snang ba: ye shes dbyings byon lha tshogs rnams: ka dag stong pa'i ngang du muṃ: dam tshig pa nyid dmigs med gyur: de nas me lha'i gtang rag ni: me kha gso zhing me lha gsal: oṃ ag+nā ye sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas gong ltar rdzas rnams lan gsum mam bdun res 'bul nas bstod pa bya: yi ge brgya pa brjod nas gshegs gsol ni: hūm̐: 'bar ba me lha 'khor dang bcas: rang bzhin gnas su gshegs su gsol: slar yang 'gro ba'i don phyir du: 'dir gshegs phrin las bzhi 'grub mdzod: badz+ra muṃ: smon lam ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bsreg blugs mchod pa 'bul ba'i mthus: bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa: sku gsum go 'phang myur thob shog: smon lam gang 'os dang bkra shis brjod: las rjes mi mngon gsang bar bya: sa ma ya: e ma myur lam gdams nas mchog: 'bar ba me yi dkyil 'khor du: brten nas lha tshogs da314)dgyes pa bskang: nyams chags dag cing tshogs rdzogs phyir: me mchod las bzhi lhun grub 'di: phyi rabs don du yi ger btab: mkhar chen gza' yis gter du sbas: ma 'ongs dus kyi mtha' ma la: shel dkar sprul pa kun dga'i ming: dī paṃ ming sogs rim gyis 'byung: 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub: skal ldan rnams dang 'phred par shog: skal med log lta'i 'gro ba la: bka' srung rnams kyis gnyer gyis shig: dam nyams rnams kyi srog dbugs sdus: yongs la ma spel gu h+ya rgya: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyis: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: ḍāk+ki'i rgya: : sa ma ya: ces pa'i me mchod zab mo 'di yan chos kyi bdag po snyan grags dang pad+ma lhun grub sogs kyis rin chen gnyis pa'i maṇ+ḍal bcas nan cher bskul ngo mi ldog tsam du mdo med sprang mo dud 'gro lta bu'i 'du shes gsum pa su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa dge'o//
